examInfo.title: Exam: {scenarioTitle}
examInfo.introduction: See how independently you can communicate in this scenario. We recommend taking the exam after you have practised this scenario.
examInfo.speech: You can only hear the character’s speech and read their actions.
examInfo.corrections: Your answers are not corrected after you send them.
examInfo.detailedAnswers: Keep the conversation going and give detailed answers to demonstrate your knowledge.
examInfo.minimumAnswers: Give at least 10 answers to enable the “{checkButton}” button. If there is not enough material to assess, continue the conversation and check your result again.
examInfo.assessment: When there is enough material, the app will assess your answers and show the result. If you achieve at least the minimum level, you will receive a medal for this specific scenario.
examInfo.recommendations: After the assessment, you will receive recommendations on how to improve your skills and demonstrate a higher level next time. You will receive recommendations whether you pass the exam or not.
